verdict.rationale: Retell's own features run unattended once configured. Deployed voice agents assigned to a phone number handle calls on their own. AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of calls against rules the user configures. Per-agent retention policies automatically delete data after a set period. However, the evidence shows no general-purpose automation builder, scheduled or recurring jobs, or event-triggered workflows, and Conductor explicitly proposes changes for human review rather than acting autonomously. missing for 10: general user-defined background automation/workflow builder, recurring scheduled tasks or campaigns, autonomous (non-review-gated) agentic actions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of your calls against rules and metrics you configure.
After the retention period expires, call and chat data associated with that agent is automatically and permanently deleted.
Assign your agent to the number in the configuration settings
